text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While heading home with Hishi Akebono
after a
day out, we talk about the
ceramics workshop
again. She's booked
another lesson and can't wait
to attend.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I've been watching loads of videos on
how to use
the pottery wheel and
looking up different
ceramics tips and
tricks, too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I know watching videos and doing
research won't
make me a master, but
it'd be nice if I could do
better than last
time!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Sir? I designed this pot to match my own

preferences, but are there rules I should
follow to
make it better?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Is there a "right way" to do this? You
know,
ceramically?

text_block_list.name: Ceramics Instructor
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to think in such black
and white
terms. No matter what you're
doing, it's probably
best to start by
taking an interest in it, then
learning to
like it.

text_block_list.name: Ceramics Instructor
text_block_list.text:
There's no right way when it comes to
creating
things. You just have to give
form to whatever it
is you wish to make.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: There's no right way...

text_block_list.name: Ceramics Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Just so. That's why it's so difficult to find
the
answer within yourself. Why, I'm still
searching
myself. Haha.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That's true... There isn't a single "right
way" to
season or prepare food. The
most important thing
is that it's delicious
and filling...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I don't really know how to explain it,
but... I think
my guts know what you
mean!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! ☆ Aaall right! I feel like now I
can really
make something to my liking.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'm going to make a pot that'll make heavenly chanko! Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When Hishi Akebono faces the pottery
wheel
again, her expression is stern but
soft, just how
she looks when she's
cooking.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although the end result isn't a
one-to-one
realization of her design, the
smoothly curved
clay pot she ends up
with is still very similar to her
draft.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's a little smaller than planned, and the
shape's a
bit different... but it looks
great! Doesn't it,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Same! Let's come pick it up together
after it's
done! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So, actually, after I watched those
pottery wheel
videos, I revisited some
recipes I wrote up when I
was a kid, and
tried cooking those dishes again.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And so many things bothered me about
them.
Like how I didn't include
ingredients that
would've made the
dishes tastier, or didn't
prepare them so
they'd look as appetizing as
possible...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
But back then, my parents never ever
told me I
had to do stuff a certain way...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yep. And it made me realize how
supportive they
were of me just doing
the best I could!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
There's really no need to overthink
things, huh?
And I'm sure that the more I
like something, the
more stuff I'll notice
when I'm doing it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
There's really no need to overthink
things, huh?
And I'm sure that the more I
like something, the
more stuff I'll notice
when I'm doing it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Is it? Hmm... In what way?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her about how it took all kinds of

experiences for me to come to love my
job and
know a lot about it. I also
explain that it's
because I love my job
that I can pick up on so
much.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe everything is the same in the
end, whether
it's cooking or ceramics.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, okay! That must mean that the
more you
come to like me, the more
awesome a trainer
you'll become!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That means I have to work super hard, so
you'll
like me even more! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's not what I meant, but... I guess
she's not
entirely wrong?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While I struggle to come up with a good

response, Hishi Akebono smiles and
nods happily
at me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Growth! So, the more we like something,
the more
we grow... That's so wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to love everything even
harder! Like
cooking and sumo wrestling
and training and you
and eeeveryone!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That way, I'll grow and improve and
become even
bigger and taller than I am
now! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! And I already love all those
things more
and more every day anyway,
so I'm sure to
improve by leaps and
bounds! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A wide smile lights up Hishi Akebono's
whole
face, and I can't help but smile
myself as we make
our way back home.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh? You mean my favorite favorite thing? Umm, gosh, what could it be?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I like eating food, but I like making it,
too! And I
like running... But pottery is
fun too, and um...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I love my dad and my mom and you, and
my
friends, too! And...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! It's impossible for me to choose
just one
thing! Everything and everyone
is my favorite,
and I love them all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
There are many other things I love too.
For
example...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I listen to her endless list of likes as the
train
home sways us back and forth.
